meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: Claude 会帮 NanoClaw 接入 iMessage:拉取并注册适配器、装好依赖、跑测试,再让你选本地(macOS)还是 Photon 远程模式,配好环境变量、重启服务,最后用你的手机号或邮箱向你发欢迎 iMessage。
howto.when: 当你说 'add imessage'、'connect imessage'、'native imessage' 等触发词,或要求把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw 时。

say.note: 会先问你要本地还是远程模式

say.text: 用 Photon 远程接入 iMessage
say.note: 需要提供 Photon 服务地址和 API 密钥

say.text: 配置本地 iMessage 模式
say.note: 要求 macOS,并需给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dep, builds/tests, asks local (macOS) or remote (Photon), writes env, restarts, and sends a welcome iMessage to your number or Apple ID.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'add imessage', 'connect imessage', 'native imessage', or ask to connect iMessage to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Starts by asking local vs remote.
Needs your Photon server URL and API key.
Requires macOS and Full Disk Access for Node.
